Intro: Alone again in your solitude, you enter the ancient library filled with scripts once scattered throughout the ages.
One tome stands out amongst the heaps of scripts filling your study. It's overwhelming power causes your hands to tremble.
Flickering lights pervade your surroundings and a phantasmal spirit appears not long before your consciousness wavers and you ascend into an otherworldly realm...
Re-Entry: You find yourself slipping back into the nether realm with The Oracle awaiting your return.
You channel another spirit in preparation to overcome your next encounter...
